text: As described, good quality, I would recommend.
Very practical for frothing.
Works well and is fairly heavy duty.  The one I received is not exactly like the one pictured. Mine has a smaller handle and is not as rounded on the bottom.  It's fine, though, and I have big hands.
nice cup and works perfectly with my new expresso machine!  Thanks!
Perfect size.
Works perfectly with my espresso machine.  Easy clean up
This is the perfect size for frothing milk for my espresso drink. Pouring is easy,  quality is great and it's holding up well after 20+uses.
Nice looking and works well!
Great quality!!!! No rust so far(after many uses and washes) love the shape!
Love it!! I bought this to go with my frother to make bulletproof coffee and it is fabulous! I am loving my coffee so much more!!
Nice product - very happy with it. Looks like the pic.

Very well made, feels very solid. I have 3 of these and use them to dissolve lye for soap-making. Run them through dishwasher multiple times. Despite exposure to highly caustic material and dishwasher detergent, several months later there are no signs of corrosion and my pitchers are still shiny. The pouring very even, without leaving drips on the body of the pitcher. Highly recommend.
Not used yet, it seems good
It is a most excellent product.
Love it!  Good quality perfect size
This is a very nice small pitcher.  Exactly what you expect.  It appears to be well made. I'd give it five stars but it's just a pitcher.
Fantastic pitcher.  Makes the best foam for my cappuccino.  Great deal.  Perfect size.  Made well . We love it.
Nice product. Quick shipping!
Love the look the sizw.  Its a great frothing pitcher.  What i dont like is that i cant preheat my milk in microwave because its metal.
used on a gas stove to warm my milk, and left it to long, boiled over and burnt on... everything..... but cleaned up beautiful. nice heavy weight.
For some reason i though this item was bigger. It is very small and it only fits a small amount of liquid.
Great using it to steam milk

I recently acquired an espresso machine and when I got it; I was surprised to learn it did not come with a frothing pitcher. I jumped on amazon in a panic to find one and came across this. I don't really know anything about frothing pitchers and I'm still now 1000% sure how to use my machine either - but this seems to be going well. It's sturdy and cleans nicely.
Great mug... Use it every morning to make my coffee with milk.
Liked, but have not used yet.
Nicely designed and constructed. Should last for many years.
Great quality. Ideal for at home frother on 3-1 machines due to its size.
I was a little skeptical of this cheap device but it  Froths milk like no other!  Works great

I am using this pitcher as a catch cup from my Kuerig. I like to drink my coffee and tea over ice but cups are too large to fit under the Kuerig machine. This is a cool look and very useful. The stainless steel is easy to clean and has many uses.

I love this.  It fits perfectly to tip sideways without going over with my machine.  Cleans up well, no too heavy to hold, handle looks uncomfortable but it isn't and it doesn't cut into my hand.  Very glad I bought this.
I use this with my Orkney Premium Milk Frother.  I highly recommend!
Does the job. Wish it had measuring markings on the inside.
This pitcher is the perfect size for my little DeLonghi espresso maker.  Very pleased with it.
Small, but just the right size for two of us.
Awesome quality and price!! Heavy stainless and very perfect size for my new espresso machine.
Excellent!
Good looking and functional
Small but perfect for one.

I bought this for my office's cappuccino maker and it has been pretty good for frothing milk. The only issue is that the spout seems a little misshapen and it ends up dribbling down the side of the pitcher most of the time when we pour.
Ended up being a lot smaller than imagined.  Used once and put on shelf.  Honestly should trash but have not had the heart to.
As expected
Well made!
Perfect size for smaller machines like the Mr. Coffee espresso maker we have with a small frothing wand. Does great with 4-8 ounces of liquid.
Nice sized pitcher for 2 cups.  However, I've discovered that I can warm the milk and froth it in microwavable item

Smaller than I had expected, but really a perfect size.
Well made with what looks like a good quality stainless steel.
Pours smoothly with no running or drips down the rim.

THIS IS NOT STAINLESS STEEL AS ADVERTISED. This was bought in Dec as a Christmas gift for my sister that lives in another state. She just told me that after a few uses little silver flakes started coming off into the milk.  "Made of high grade stainless steel with a capacity of 12 Oz (350 ml)" Stainless steel does not flake and come off.
Nice cup, great quality, the price was right!
A great item just for the right price. If you are looking for a good pitcher and affordable I will recommend you to buy this one. Simple, elegant and affordable.
Seems high quality and sturdy.
Did'nt realize how small it would be, but it works great!
Great product
The best
good product !
Durable & cleans up easy.  No pitting or staining after repeated use.
Perfect just what I needed with promptly delivered good price
Product looked used when it arrived.  Sent it back for refund.
Great small milk pitcher. Clean and works for just what I need! Quick delivery! Great value!

Great introductory espresso maker, makes good espresso quickly and is simple to operate. Push button - wait for light - turn knob on - turn knob off. Take the stupid rubber tip off the milk steamer tho it's a pain
Works great, very good quality for the price.
Exactly what we were looking for
I have several 12oz frothing pitchers. This Utopia is much better than any of the others. Heavier and obviously higher quality. Highly recommend!
I love it !  Sturdy little pitcher that is just he right size to fit under my espresso maker spout.  I use it for expresso and it holds 3 shots nicely.

Does the job nicely. Fits under frothing arm on drip tray. Handle extends from the body of the pitcher far enough to not burn your fingers during the frothing process. Makes enough froth for one large or 2 small cups.
Great to Froth milk!
exactly as described. Note the size. I thought it would be much bigger.

Mine had some rough and sharp unfinished areas around the top edge so that is why only 3 stars. A minute of sanding with some 600 grit wet/dry paper removed those. I can still feel and see one bad area but it is no longer sharp and not at the spout. Otherwise the pitcher is just the right size. I already had 6 other frothing pitchers but needed a 12oz and this is just the right height and volume. Unlike my other's, there is no stamped marking on the bottom at all - usually I see the grade and type of metal and the country of origin (typically  "18/8 stainless steel made in china") but mine has nothing there. Regardless, it is fairly heavy gauge ss with 2 solid spot welds at each end of the handle attaching it to the pitcher, and it feels good in the hand. The spout is decent shape for pouring latte art, so overall a good value for the money.
Good quality.
Ecellent quality
Durable and a very good price

i love everything about this pitcher. the size is the right one for single/couple coffees: not too small, not too big.
it has the right shape and even more, it's a handsome pitcher.
Just what I needed!

I was skeptical about this purchase but since I recently broke the unreplaceable part to my Bodum French Press, soon to be a terrarium, morning coffee has not been great. I was pleasantly surprised by the enhanced flavor that was saved from my freshly ground coffee beans with this small appliance! It does the job well when instructions are followed and cleans easily.

Smoothest cup of coffee I've had yet.

I don't write reviews often but it was clear when I held this little beauty in my hands that a lot of love was put into the design. I used premium fine ground coffee and the result was a pour over that would give a barrista a run for their money. I've used the aeropress but this beats it for convenience and taste. As a bonus, its clean from the dishwasher so the cleanup is super easy.

Worth getting!
No filters any more! Great pour over. Will absolutely buy again
It lasted 3 months before the shoddy welding on the base gave out and it separated from the mesh; creating a gap that just lets everything through.

Simplest way to make a great cup of coffee is to pour hot water over coffee grounds in a filter in a cone, and this reusable stainless steel fine-mesh filter is a great solution.  Nice and solid.  Easy to use. Easy to clean. You can use it to make a single cup or a whole pot of coffee.  And saves the expense of using paper filters.  Highly recommend for any coffee lover who wants a simple way to make coffee without a lot of gadgetry.
Couldn't be happier,  great product at a great price!

This pour over rocks! Here's the deal: too many pour overs require paper inserts. MESSY. This one does not. So much easier. And cleaner for the neat freak inside me. Plus the coffee from the Bartelli tastes delish. And that's what I'm really after.

Lastly, the Bartelli looks super sweet. It's the coffee dripper I'm proud to have out on my counter, rather then hiding it away in the cabinets.

excellent quality should last for years...was easy to use, easy to clean, and makes excellent coffee..
I plan to use primarily when power goes out, I heat water on my gas stove and go from there.....
I could not be happier, great little investment, will be worth it's weight in gold next time power goes out...

I had used a single serve filter system with a gold filter in the past and liked it.
This is so much BETTER. Yes no paper filters and no gold plate to wear/clean off
after time. This is stainless steel and cleans so easy, the best is it makes good
coffee. No fine grind, just ground coffee.
I'm glad I spent the money on this.
Works great!

This easy-cleaning filter is the only thing I use to make morning coffee -- having tired of the time it takes to make a whole pot of press filter coffee, and hating the taste of the coffeemaker carafe system I bought from Melitta -- oily and metallic after a time.
Tired of crappy coffee?  The Bartelli delivers a wonderful cup of coffee.  Easy to use.  Easy to clean.
So easy to use and just the perfect size.

Opted for this paperless coffee dripper instead of using paper filters and a plastic dripper.  I read that the coffee's natural oils are absorbed by the paper and more are left when going paperless, I find this to be true.  Very happy with this product.  Have been using it for about 2 months now.  Just lovely.
Works perfect from one cup to a liter,  could not be better.

After only a few uses it became clogged so that the water would basically not drain through at all. I see now others have the same problem and they are recommending soaking in vinegar and brushing with a bristle brush etc. etc. Don't have the time for all that so back to the paper filter it is!

I have been looking for a paperless filter for a while now so I tried it as soon as it arrived. It did a great job. I now have something for my coffee when camping or if I run out of filters. I also read that most commercial coffee filters are coated with a chemical (chlorine which is used in the cleaning and bleaching process). So good bye paper filters.

If there was a drawback it would have to be with the cleaning. It takes a bit more time to clean it but that is a small price to pay. I would highly recommend this product.
I really like this filter. The coffee is a lot like a french press as far as flavor, but with fewer dregs. It's a really easy way to make just one cup.
Beautiful piece of equipment! Well made, nice finish.
Great!

I have had this filter for 7 months and it has seen much use. I found, initially, that this was exactly what I wanted; flawlessly flavored coffee with no plastic adding their poisons to the mix. Today, the inadequate weldings that held the bottom plate to the sieve gave way in the dishwasher. For such an expensive(40 dollars)item you would think the quality would be impeccable, not so for this filter! So, I give it one star for the construction of the sieve part of the filter and one star for the great coffee it makes but remove 3 stars for shoddy construction, the fact that it gets clogged up too often and for it's ridiculous price. For anyone who has had the same experience, I was able to affect a suitable repair by drilling a small hole through the center of the sieve and the base and securing them with a stainless steel pop riveter(only about 20 dollars to buy), I hope the Bartelli company will remake this product with stronger welding so this will not occur in the future.

Nice. Much better than one I was using bought in a coffee shop (paint was coming off!!)
Love knowing it is stainless steel and I can still use filters.
Great product
Great quality and even travels well
Simple easy quick.  Not my cemex, but for a single cup before work this is a must buy.  Pretty much killed my kureg.
Coffee gets stuck between the mesh; begins to make coffee taste terrible.
Great product.  Use with expresso (bustello and la llave) and no grinds make it thru.
Love this thing
The mesh is too fine and clogs. Only good for making a small cup of coffee. Once it gets clogged it's hard to clean. Will end up drilling holes and adding a paper filter to make it useful.
This suddenly stopped working.  I did like it... when it worked!
Super little filter. Now i can have one big hot cup of strong coffee with no drama.
Love it! Makes a great cup of coffee with very little clean up

This is a super high-quality coffee dripper. I am very impressed with how easy it is to use and clean, especially since you don't have to clean an extra pitcher. The coffee grounds steep very well and I can taste the difference between light, medium, and dark roasts. Do yourself a favor and invest into one of these!

**2-Week Update: You will need basic coffee filters if you want to keep all grounds out. I tried using this with my ground coffee but without a filter and there was definitely sediment in the bottom. If I were you, don't waste money on those expensive Chemex/pourover filters. Just fold a regular coffee filter into a cone, dampen it with water, and then add in grounds before the pour over.
We love it. Perfect for our coffee pour overs. High quality.
Works fine, but it's a slow process and the coffee doesn't come out all that strong.
Excellent, practical and beautiful device. I never knew how good pour-over coffee can taste until I tried this. Easy to use and clean. I like it!
Great product!
Love this gadget!!! Makes preparation of my daily frappaccino so easy!! Purchased one for my daughter also.
It worked well for a few months, but now does not work. The water just sits on top of the grounds.

DO NOT BUY. STOPS WORKING AFTER FEW WEEKS, SLOWER AND SLOWER, WASTES COFFEE. SELLER NON-RESPONSIVE.
DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY.
Girlfriend loved the product. She had been wanting one for a long time.
Love. This.
Perfect !!! Love my coffee even more !!! ;)
I use this to make cold brew. I've tried many like this but this is the only one that hasn't fallen apart
After a while it gets clogged from the coffee and the water doesn't go down at all, and there's no way to clean it inside.

I have one of these made by SSI that came with a stainless steel spoon.  This one drains more slowly than the SSI, but the results are a stronger cup of coffee.  It works well, cleans easily, and is well-built.

At first I loved this coffee dripper! However as time has gone by it is taking longer and longer for the water to seep through. It's not an issue of cleaning the filter/dripper because I've done so consistently. I'm not sure why this is happening. I'm now back to using a standard dripper with a paper filter :(
Love it. It's big. I was looking for small coffee dripper without the base. However, I love it.

I can make one cup occasionally instead of consuming large amounts of coffee with a coffee maker, my coffee maker just went into the garbage. I LOVE IT! I was worried that it would not clean well and would stain and clog it cleans well with no coffee stain or clogging. This is one of the best products I have ever purchased in my life. No more paper filters to buy.
Love, love, love this. Love that it is stainless and you just need to rinse it out, love that it make great coffee. I own 2, one for home and one for work and I juts bought 2 more for gifts.

Works great.  Saves on buying paper filters.  Have to use a bit of dish soap to wash it clean enough to allow easy flow each time.  Doesn't allow anything but drinkable coffee to get through.  No sediment even.

This pour over filter fails due to its double filter. After a couple weeks of dark roast coffe at a medium grind the filter became so clogged with fines it would not drain completely even after 5 minutes. I tried coarser grinds and different pour styles to brew my coffee but because of the very slow drip it consistently over brewed.

Unfortunately there is no good way to clean the filter either. Certainly following the manufacturer directions and washing it with water won't do the trick. No matter how I scrubbed, what kind of brush I used, or how much boiling water I filtered through when held up to the light it was obvious that the filter was clogged with the fine bits of the coffee grind.

I'm giving two stars because the fix was simple enough....use paper filters. But it is supposed to be a paperless filter, so if you're going to buy one that needs filters there are plenty of other options.
Looks great!
Works very well for making single servings of coffee. I use along with an electronic kettle and prefer the taste over a normal coffee pot.

because when you pour water into the filter only some of it will stay inside of the filter and rest of the water just leak through the side of the filter. but if you like your coffee watery, get this filter. It'll fix a weak cup of coffee like a pro.

We LOVE this strainer! No need for filters and makes a delicious cup of coffee!  I just gave it to my boyfriend as a birthday present and he loves it so much he wants to buy some to give as Christmas presents.  If any local stores carry your product, please let me know.  Our zip is 90740.  Thanks for a great product!

There is nothing I don't like about this product. Makes great coffee. Lightweight. The handle doesn't get hot. Drips at the right speed. My favorite thing is that there's an opening at the bottom of the cone, so you can watch as your mug fills up with coffee, so you don't over-fill it. 5 1/2 stars.
Ordered this for a friend who drinks coffee throughout the day, to replace the plastic pour over/paper filter system he was using before. He loves it! Great item at a great price.
Love it. No paper liners and easy to clean. Stainless steel makes it good boating choice.
Great quality

I love this coffee filter!  I was looking for something to replace my Keurig, since I am fed up with buying the little cups, being unable to get the body of the machine clean enough (there are always floaters in my reservoir no matter what I do), and being unable to get a decent cup of coffee out of the reusable filters available for the machine.  I also needed a single cup option, since I am a mom of little ones who works from home and homeschools and am never able to get through even one cup before it gets cold.  Anyway, I wanted something reusable, easy to keep clean, and without the need to purchase anything additional to make it work (i.e. filters).  My problem with regular reusable filters is that I always seem to end up with sediment in the bottom of my mug. I hate drinking dirt water.  This filter has such a fine mesh that I never end up with sediment in my cup, even with a fine ground coffee.  It filters quickly (by the time I pour the water through it's almost done, and by the time I heat the milk for a few seconds it's definitely done), which is also a must for me.  I use it several times a day and have no problem keeping it clean-I did take the advice of one reviewer and throw it in the dishwasher after about a week, but it wasn't draining slowly before that.  I rinse after every use, though, so it stays pretty clean.  If you are looking for a good pour over coffee filter, this is the one to buy.  I'll never go back.  The coffee tastes so good and is so easy to ma

Worked well initially, but after about a week, the dripping would slow down dramatically. I don't use it anymore at this point, since it takes so long for a cup of hot water to go through the filter that when the cup of coffee is finally brewed, it is usually lukewarm. Love the idea of going paperless, but I'm quite disappointed with the product.
No old growth forests were clear cut to make a single use paper product for my coffee.  My coffee has to travel far enough. I don't need fsc certified filters either! BOOM! I love this thing!

Made very cheaply.It wobbles and lets sediment and even grounds through.
It lets more grounds through that out old plastic dripper.
Would not recommend, or buy again.
I used this twice to make excellent coffee, washed after each use like a normal person would. Then the coffee just stopped flowing through. Would not buy again.

This worked for a bit. For $35.00 I expected it to last for YEARS.  It is permanently clogged in some way and will not filter coffee at all.  I would like to figure out how to get a refund since the add says they guarantee the product.

Great pour over!

This filter should be cleaned thoroughly after every use for best results.
This is an excellent made product and does what it is supposed to do
Excellent product. No more messy paper cones; just rinse to clean Sturdy and attractive; should last a lifetime.

Although the filter itself is perfect for what I wanted, the quality of the tack weld spots holding the base to the filter and then the screen to the ring, are just awful. In a matter of months the bottom fell off, and now I have only one weld spot holding the conical screen to the upper ring. For the money spent on this filter I would definitely NOT purchase this product again. I wish it weren't too late to get my money back on this substandard filter.

This was a great filter until it wasn't. After a few months this filter stopped working, meaning no water would flow through it. I assume it had gotten clogged. I always use pretty coarsely ground coffee and rinsed the filter after use.  When the filtering started slowing down I tried soaking the filter in hot water. I read online that a lot of other people had the same problem and I tried all the different suggested methods to fix the problem, but nothing worked so I had to stop using this filter and buy a different one.  I had high hopes for this filter when I first got it.  A friend visited me and admired it, so I bought her one as a gift.  I saw her recently and had to apologize for buying such a crappy gift. She felt bad telling me that my gift was in the trash.  I wish one of the fixes worked because I really hate throwing out products when they don't work anymore.

As others have said, the filter is easily clogged to the point where hot water will not even flow through after about a month of use.  If there was a way to unclog it, I would love to know.  Good quality though.
works well and easy to clean
I bought this as a gift for my husband and he is in love! I like that its metal and won't crack like the other one we had. This is easy to clean and does the job!

this $20 product produces very weak coffee. the problem appears to be that it has too many holes that cause the water to drain too rapidly. it is also a chore to clean it. My $3 Melitta cone is far superior.
Arrived on time and was exactly what was expected.
I have had this product for two years.  It worked great for the first year, but now it clogs all the time and takes much, much longer to make coffee.

We bought this for my husband to use on a deployment at the recommendation of a friend. It's fantastic for him to not have to worry about replacing filters. Easy clean up and it produces a delicious cup of coffee.
The water never goes through. I tried all different  grind settings and it takes so long, that the water is cold by the time it seeps through.
